name: project-card-maker
description: > Transform books, PDFs, and syllabi into concise study cards with AI

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "AI,BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,green" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../ai-service && pip install -r requirements.txt
